title: desmodium discolor var. villosum
intro: Desmodium discolor var. villosum, commonly known as Velloso's tick trefoil, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It is valued for its traditional use in medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Desmodium discolor var. villosum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
